scope_guards.monthly_snapshot: Monthly BDUK contract figures are rounded management-information snapshots with ingestion lag; they do not establish exact-address completion, current service availability, orderability or contractual milestone performance.
scope_guards.monthly_comparison: A May-to-July difference is arithmetic between rounded BDUK snapshots and may reflect scope changes, resubmissions or ingestion timing; it is not a parcel-level build claim or milestone assessment.
scope_guards.consumer_rule: Automatic-compensation eligibility, signatories and payment rules govern qualifying consumer processes and do not establish current network availability at an address.
scope_guards.coverage_snapshot: Connected Nations figures are national or aggregated coverage snapshots and predictions; they do not guarantee current orderability or performance at an exact address.
scope_guards.regulatory: Market-review scope and regulatory statements describe wholesale market regulation and do not establish parcel connectivity.
scope_guards.voucher_rule: Voucher-scheme eligibility and audit rules describe programme processes and do not prove that a particular address is eligible, connected or orderable.
